purpose: Portable provenance for the bounded source claims and search candidates. This is an open starting catalog, not a whitelist. Freshly verify claims that exceed recorded access or depend on current evidence.
review_origin: Russian source review on 2026-10-06, adapted into English; these records do not claim a new full-text audit.
limits: Selected passages, excerpts or abstracts only as stated. No full-book reading implied.
No source establishes effectiveness of the complete AI partner or its PROD exercises.
Repeated works across routes are not independent corroboration.
Candidate status permits investigation and case-specific use after verification; it is not a permanent exclusion.

records.authors: Jason A. Colquitt, Donald E. Conlon, Michael J. Wesson, Christopher O. L. H. Porter & K. Yee Ng
records.title: Justice at the Millennium: A Meta-Analytic Review of 25 Years of Organizational Justice Research
records.access: Full text available; only named sections read
records.read_sections: pp.425–428: definitions and construct discrimination
confirmed_claims: 183 studies; distributive, procedural, interpersonal and informational dimensions are related but distinguishable.
Organizational justice concerns perceived fairness and correlates.
Voice/process control is one aspect of procedure.
limitations: Not the separate sole-author Colquitt scale-development paper.
Not a universal moral verdict or validated product checklist.
Equal allocation is not always the chosen fairness principle.
